claims.content: To report ballistic missile tracks and coordinate them in the Surveillance Network via JDS, Link, and AORs.

goal.raw_text: To report ballistic missile tracks and coordinate them in the Surveillance Network via JDS, Link, and AORs.

claims.content: The C2 JU has detected a ballistic missile track or point that meets the criteria for reporting (e.g., complete, accurate, and timely as per paragraph 4.4.5.2.a).
The track data has been correlated, and its designation is maintained (paragraph 4.4.5.2.b).
For a ballistic missile track, the source of the track shall be provided (paragraph 4.4.5.2.a).
If applicable, designated local ballistic missile track/points have been correlated with a known trackpoint received by the detecting JU system to the interface as an active TU (paragraph 4.4.5.2.c).
For real-time tracks, the C2 JU is prepared to report the actual or expected impact point of the ballistic missile (paragraph 4.4.5.3).
The C2 JU detects a ballistic missile track or point that meets the criteria for reporting (e.g., complete, accurate, and timely).
The C2 JU correlates the track data and maintains its designation.
If applicable, the C2 JU correlates the designated local ballistic missile track/point with a known trackpoint received by the detecting JU system to the interface as an active TU.
For real-time tracks, the C2 JU prepares to report the actual or expected impact point of the ballistic missile.
The C2 JU reports the ballistic missile surveillance information via JDS, Link, and AORs as specified in paragraphs 4.4.5.2 through 4.4.5.6.
